financed_project.definition: Financed scope capex is paid at year zero; yearly cash flows deduct loan interest only. Principal repayments are excluded here because the full financed-scope capex is included at year zero. Equity cash flows separately deduct full debt service. Electrification is in this scope only when loan_include_electrification is enabled; conversion capex never enters the deduction basis.

solar_equity.definition: Solar-only equity cash flows allocate loan principal and debt service proportionally: solar_loan_principal = min(principal, solar_capex), with yearly debt service scaled by solar_loan_ratio = solar_loan_principal / total_principal. Year 0 equity outlay is -solar_capex + solar_loan_principal (initial solar equity = solar_capex - solar_loan_principal), and yearly flows deduct allocated debt service. When package loan is selected (loan_include_electrification=True), total principal covers combined solar and conversion capex up to borrowing limits, allocating debt service without double deducting capex or principal.

package_equity.definition: Package equity cash flows cover solar plus electrification conversion capex net of total loan principal at year 0, and deduct full annual debt service (principal and interest) in each operating year.

ratio_definitions.seasonal_performance_factor_delivered_he: Ratio of useful qualified delivered heat (space heating + DHW draw service) to total electricity input (compressor + resistance backup + auxiliary pump and standby). Excludes unserved lukewarm water withdrawals and does not add tank storage delta into delivered service.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_performance_factor_storage_adju: Storage-adjusted seasonal performance factor: (space qualified delivered + DHW qualified delivered + storage delta) / total electricity input. Discloses initial vs final tank storage energy; null if numerator is negative.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_performance_factor_heat_to_tank: Ratio of space delivered heat plus thermal heat delivered by compressor and backup to the DHW cylinder to total electricity input.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_scop_space: Seasonal coefficient of performance for space heating: space useful delivered heat / (space compressor electricity + space resistance backup electricity). Explicitly excludes auxiliaries.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_scop_dhw_net: Seasonal coefficient of performance for DHW: net DHW service (delivered draw heat + storage delta) / (DHW compressor electricity + DHW backup electricity). Excludes unserved lukewarm water.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_scop_dhw_delivered: Seasonal coefficient of performance for delivered DHW service: qualified delivered draw heat / (DHW compressor electricity + DHW backup electricity).
ratio_definitions.seasonal_space_cop: Seasonal space heating compressor COP: space compressor thermal output at equipment boundary / space compressor electricity.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_dhw_cop_heat_to_tank: Seasonal DHW compressor COP: DHW compressor thermal output to cylinder / DHW compressor electricity.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_compressor_cop: Total compressor COP: (space compressor heat + DHW compressor heat) / (space compressor electricity + DHW compressor electricity).

assumptions.description: EMS work mode for the physical dispatch kernel. Auto evaluates battery-first, grid-first, scheduled AM/PM and dynamic clipping reserve for the active system and picks the highest median equity NPV mode; the sidebar stays Auto until a recommendation is applied. Battery-first is the standard self-use inverter mode (Load -> Battery -> Grid). Grid-first exports sub-inverter surplus and only charges from over-inverter DC power (Load -> Clipping Recapture -> Grid -> Battery). Scheduled AM/PM uses grid-first before the switch hour during the configured active months to preserve midday clipping headroom. Dynamic clipping reserve caps morning sub-inverter charging at SoC ceiling = usable capacity minus remaining over-inverter capturable energy.

limitations: All financial/eligibility settings are pending scenarios; cost inputs are placeholders until itemized quotes.
All 2 historic weather years are repeated separately over project life, not randomly sampled or probabilistic.
Battery aging is annual capacity stepping based on cumulative model cycles; string/bypass, standby losses and hourly tariff/load changes remain unmodeled.
PV-to-battery dispatch uses the selected ac_equivalent approximation with AC-equivalent PVGIS inputs; product-specific joint-output constraints are unmodeled.
EV scenario includes electrification; vehicle cost and mobility benefits excluded.
CER eligible share is assumed, not reconstructed community hourly sharing.

Actual supplied hourly GME price profile is normalized to selected baseload forecast. The export price factor starts at 1.0 in the first modeled year, ramps linearly to actual_price_future_factor after export_price_future_years elapsed years, then stays constant; export_capture_factor is not applied again to this observed shape. Import prices and physical dispatch are unchanged.

Air-to-water heat pump model active: useful space and domestic hot water heating demands are calibrated from the explicitly supplied 12-month thermal reference, converted to hourly electrical power input using temperature-dependent compressor performance maps, weather compensation, and stratified DHW cylinder storage dynamics.

Provisional heat pump equipment ratings include nominal 9.0 kW thermal capacity and 10.0 kW emitter capacity at Delta-T 50. Emitter sizing, distribution circuit losses, and dwelling thermal envelope characteristics remain unverified placeholders.

Multi-year weather records (2023–2024) are used as climatology analogues. Building thermal capacitance, indoor dynamic room temperature decay, and thermal comfort are not modeled (no RC / comfort validation); unmet space or water heating is explicitly tracked and remains unmet.
Heat pump service is fully comparable across all modeled weather years (unmet space and DHW thermal demand within numerical tolerance).
User local research adopted without fresh web verification; raw mapping errors corrected (capture once,6kWp catalog capex calibrated).
Gas run rate is an annual approximation from flat August regulated unit costs, not measured twelve-month billed expenditure.

metadata.emitter_disclaimer: Provisional EN 442 radiator rating; actual installed emitters and dwelling thermal characteristics remain unverified.
metadata.boiler_efficiency_disclaimer: Estimated existing gas boiler seasonal efficiency (unverified user estimate 0.80).
metadata.gas_elimination_status: Gas service is not eliminated if cooking remains on natural gas.
metadata.source_period: Explicit profile reference period gas reference and climatology 2023–2024
metadata.weather_reference_basis: Fixed monthly thermal budgets vs weather-sensitive climatology reference (2023–2024 PVGIS ensemble; no coincident weather for Explicit profile reference period)
metadata.measured_vs_assumed: Gross electricity and thermal baseline quantities come from explicit profile inputs. Equipment performance, emitters, tank losses and seasonal efficiency are modeling assumptions unless separately evidenced.
metadata.balance_temperature_distinction: Configured indoor comfort temperature is conceptually distinct from outdoor heating balance temperature.
metadata.comfort_and_recovery_validation: No comfort or recovery validation: dynamic building RC network, room temperature decay during setback/unheated hours, and recovery morning reheat surges are not modeled; unmet thermal demands are explicitly reported and remain unmet.
metadata.building_dynamics_disclaimer: No house RC network, unheated cooldown electricity, or fabricated reheat recovery peak spikes modeled.
metadata.schedule_and_loss_limitations: Space heating and DHW draw/reheat subject to configured operating schedules and prior DHW standing loss limitations.

ratio_definitions.seasonal_performance_factor_delivered_he: Ratio of useful qualified delivered heat (space heating + DHW draw service) to total electricity input (compressor + resistance backup + auxiliary pump and standby). Excludes unserved lukewarm water withdrawals and does not add tank storage delta into delivered service.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_performance_factor_storage_adju: Storage-adjusted seasonal performance factor: (space qualified delivered + DHW qualified delivered + storage delta) / total electricity input. Discloses initial vs final tank storage energy; null if numerator is negative.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_performance_factor_heat_to_tank: Ratio of space delivered heat plus thermal heat delivered by compressor and backup to the DHW cylinder to total electricity input.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_scop_space: Seasonal coefficient of performance for space heating: space useful delivered heat / (space compressor electricity + space resistance backup electricity). Explicitly excludes auxiliaries.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_scop_dhw_net: Seasonal coefficient of performance for DHW: net DHW service (delivered draw heat + storage delta) / (DHW compressor electricity + DHW backup electricity). Excludes unserved lukewarm water.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_scop_dhw_delivered: Seasonal coefficient of performance for delivered DHW service: qualified delivered draw heat / (DHW compressor electricity + DHW backup electricity).
ratio_definitions.seasonal_space_cop: Seasonal space heating compressor COP: space compressor thermal output at equipment boundary / space compressor electricity.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_dhw_cop_heat_to_tank: Seasonal DHW compressor COP: DHW compressor thermal output to cylinder / DHW compressor electricity.
ratio_definitions.seasonal_compressor_cop: Total compressor COP: (space compressor heat + DHW compressor heat) / (space compressor electricity + DHW compressor electricity).
